label: D2 of a common a2->S2 trial right after a rewarded trial (episode trials 3-49)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2), with the previous trial rewarded. Being active on 1% of steps, it also only fires in episode trials 3-49; it is silent from trial 50 on, which is odd, and it is stronger in low_first episodes and when value is high (>8.1). Every variable is observed at D2, so no future variables. Dev: recall 0.998, mass recall 0.998, precision 0.25, F1 0.41. What drives magnitude: activation is largest on the FIRST a2->S2c trial after a reward that followed an unrewarded trial, and it decays fast across repeated rewarded a2->S2c trials (0.73, 0.21, 0.05). Adding tv(prev_reward,-1)!=1 gives precision 0.36 and mass recall 0.90 but count recall 0.65. Peak activations occur on rare rewarded a1->S2 trials. Never fires at D1/GO, after a1->S1, after rare transitions to S1, or after an unrewarded previous trial.
